compute.basis: Once the pickle is in hand, flattening 300x8 segments and fitting KMeans + 95th-percentile threshold is seconds of CPU work; the estimate is dominated by install and data handling, not compute.

title: EngineAD: A Real-World Vehicle Engine Anomaly Detection Dataset
